Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Technology Stack
Content:
## Solution Map (10 Projects)

MemorySmith.Agent.slnx contains 10 projects:

| Project | Path | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| Agent.Core | Agent.Core/Agent.Core.csproj | Core abstractions, interfaces, models, events, runtime components |
| Agent.Memory | Agent.Memory/Agent.Memory.csproj | MemorySmith REST gateway, blueprint repository, item registry |
| Agent.Planning | Agent.Planning/Agent.Planning.csproj | Goals, decomposers, planners, intent manager, LLM integration |
| Agent.Personality | Agent.Personality/Agent.Personality.csproj | Chat interpretation, agent profile |
| Agent.Tools | Agent.Tools/Agent.Tools.csproj | 14 ITool implementations + ToolDispatcher |
| Agent.Vision | Agent.Vision/Agent.Vision.csproj | Vision processing (stub) |
| Agent.Construction | Agent.Construction/Agent.Construction.csproj | Blueprint parser, executor, schema |
| Agent.World.Minecraft | Agent.World.Minecraft/Agent.World.Minecraft.csproj | Minecraft adapter, WebSocket bridge |
| WebUI.Blazor | WebUI.Blazor/WebUI.Blazor.csproj | Blazor Server host, dashboard, agent background service |
| MemorySmith.Agent.Tests | MemorySmith.Agent.Tests/MemorySmith.Agent.Tests.csproj | NUnit test suite (746+ tests) |

## Runtime

**Runtime:** .NET 10, C# 14 (latest), net10.0 target framework across all projects, .slnx solution format. Nullable enabled, implicit usings enabled, TreatWarningsAsErrors=true in Directory.Build.props (NU1903 exempted as transitive advisory policy).

**Host/DI:** WebApplication.CreateBuilder (minimal API host), Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection, hosted services via BackgroundService (AgentBackgroundService).

## Logging & Telemetry

**Serilog** with multiple sinks:
- Console sink (custom output template, colorized)
- Rolling file sink (14-day retention, Debug+ level, logs/memorysmith-agent-*.log)
- LiveLogBuffer + DashboardLogSink for live streaming to dashboard via SignalR
- Per-namespace log level overrides via Agent:Logging config section

**OpenTelemetry** (opt-in in MemorySmith.App): tracing and metrics with configurable exporters.

## Web/API

- **ASP.NET Core** (Web SDK) with controllers and minimal API
- **SignalR** for real-time dashboard updates (live logs, agent status, goal progress)
- **Swagger/OpenAPI** via Swashbuckle (AddSwaggerGen)
- **System.Text.Json** serialization with JsonStringEnumConverter
- **Request guard middleware**: ApiKey enforcement, AllowRemoteApi
- **Blazor Server** interactive components with **MudBlazor 9.x** UI library

## HTTP & Resilience

- IHttpClientFactory with named clients ("memorysmith", "memorysmith-world")
- **Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience** for AddStandardResilienceHandler (retry with backoff + circuit breaker — Sprint 53 TSK-0194)

## WebSocket

- System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket for C#→Node.js bridge (Agent.World.Minecraft WebSocketBridge)

## Storage

- **SQLite** via Microsoft.Data.Sqlite for metadata, security, audit, settings
- File-backed stores for memories (FileMemoryStore), pages, events (FileEventStore — JSONL audit log)

## Search

- **Lucene.NET** for BM25 lexical search
- Optional ONNX Runtime for embedding ranker with token-scoring fallback
- Hybrid search via RRF fusion

## MCP Endpoint

- HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint at /mcp with 22-tool catalog (search, context pack, memory CRUD, source bundle, task management)

## Test Packages (MemorySmith.Agent.Tests.csproj)

| Package | Version | Purpose |
|---------|---------|---------|
| NUnit | 4.6.1 | Test framework |
| NUnit3TestAdapter | 6.2.0 | Test adapter for dotnet test |
| NUnit.Analyzers | 4.14.0 | Roslyn analyzers for NUnit best practices |
| Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk | 18.7.0 | .NET test SDK |
| coverlet.collector | 10.0.1 | Code coverage collection |
| GitHubActionsTestLogger | 3.0.4 | CI annotations in GitHub Actions |
| Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing | 10.0.9 | Integration testing (ApiKeyMiddleware) |

## Node.js Side

- **Mineflayer** (^4.x) for Minecraft bot automation
- **mineflayer-pathfinder** for pathfinding (Movements + pathfinder)
- **ws** (WebSocket library) for C#↔Node.js bridge
- pvxb utility for version checking

## MCP Server (MemorySmith.App)

The MemorySmith main repo exposes an MCP HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint at /mcp with tools including search, memory CRUD, task management, code search, and source bundle retrieval. Used by the agent for long-term memory access.

## Key Interfaces (quick reference)

| Interface | Location | Purpose |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| IGoal | Agent.Core | Goal evaluation; DamageInterruptThresholdHp per-goal override |
| IPlanner | Agent.Planning | PlanAsync + ReplanAsync |
| IGoalDecomposer | Agent.Planning | Pluggable goal decomposition (CanHandle + Decompose) |
| IReplanGovernor | Agent.Planning | Stall detection (IsStalled, RecordPlan, RecordProgress) |
| IAgentJournal | Agent.Core | Append-only event log |
| IWorldModel | Agent.Core | Observe / Predict / Reconcile / Uncertainty |
| IMemoryGateway | Agent.Memory | Search / GetPage / CreatePage / UpdatePage |
| ITool | Agent.Tools | Name, Description, InputSchema, ExecuteAsync |
| IWorldAdapter | Agent.World.Minecraft | Connect, SendAction, ReceiveEvents |
| IChatInterpreter | Agent.Personality | InterpretAsync → ChatInterpretation |
| ILlmEvaluator | Agent.Core | Evaluate ActionOutcome[] → should replan? |

**Runtime:** .NET 10, C# 14 (latest), net10.0 target framework across all projects, .slnx solution format. Nullable enabled, implicit usings enabled, TreatWarningsAsErrors=true in Directory.Build.props (NU1903 exempted as transitive advisory policy).

**Host/DI:** WebApplication.CreateBuilder (minimal API host), Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection, hosted services via BackgroundService (AgentBackgroundService).

**Logging & Telemetry:** Serilog with console sink (custom output template), rolling file sink (14-day retention, Debug+ level, logs/memorysmith-agent-*.log), LiveLogBuffer + DashboardLogSink for live streaming to dashboard via SignalR. **Search:** Lucene.NET for BM25 lexical search, optional ONNX Runtime for embedding ranker with token-scoring fallback, hybrid search via RRF fusion.

Moq or manual mock implementations (MockMemoryGateway, MockWorldAdapter).

## Node.js Side

**Runtime:** Node.js 22+, ESM modules (type:module in package.json).

**Dependencies:** mineflayer ^4.23.0 (Minecraft bot), mineflayer-pathfinder ^2.4.5 (A* navigation + movements), ws ^8.18.0 (WebSocket server).

## MemorySmith Backend

MemorySmith (https://github.com/TheMasonX/MemorySmith) is a single-host ASP.NET Core 10 app with Blazor Server UI, REST API at /api/search and /api/pages, MCP endpoint at /mcp, BM25 + embedding hybrid search, file-backed storage, SQLite metadata DB. Runs as a service or console app on http://localhost:5089 by default.
